subject: Q4 Goal Charter & QBR prep — cross-functional signoff needed
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Collins <hannah.collins@northbridgeconsulting.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q4 Goal Charter & QBR prep — cross-functional signoff needed

Team,

Attached is the first draft of the Q4 Goal Charter (Q4_OKR_Charter_v1.xlsx). I pulled together a compact set of company-level objectives plus candidate key results. High-level asks:

- Please review objective wording for clarity and measurability.
- Flag any blockers for delivery (resources, vendor dependencies) by EOD Thursday.
- Confirm which metrics we will highlight in the QBR deck.

Notes: I intentionally kept the company objectives to three items to force prioritization. Marcus — appreciate your take on the product-impact KRs. Vivek — would like your read on capacity assumptions; I expect some tradeoffs with Dedicated roadmap. Karthik/Laura — ops & GTM impact + comms plan.

I’ve cc’d Hannah to keep the QBR facilitator looped; she will run the QBR coordination checklist once we sign off.

Next step: consolidate feedback and meet Friday 4/9 10:30–11:00am PT for final signoff. Calendar invite to follow.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q4_OKR_Charter_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-06T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 Goal Charter & QBR prep — cross-functional signoff needed

Lauren — thanks for pulling this together. Quick thoughts after a pass:

- Company Objective 2 (Serve more production workloads) — suggest replacing "more" with a concrete target: increase production customers using Dedicated by 30% (or +X committed capacity).
- Product KR1 (latency P95) — tighten the SLA target to a measurable % reduction, e.g., "P95 inference latency reduction by 20% for standard routes."
- Add a KR for "regression budget" tied to Optimize rollout (so Product & Research are aligned).

I added a short comment column in the spreadsheet where I suggested number targets. I did not change the objective text to preserve your framing.

Also cc'ing Hannah — anything you think the QBR facilitator will need that isn't in the outline?

—Marcus
Principal Product Manager

Date: 2027-04-07T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 Goal Charter & QBR prep — cross-functional signoff needed

Lauren — thanks. I updated the resourcing assumptions and attached resourcing_plan_v2.xlsx. Major items:

- The Dedicated capacity ramp we have in the plan assumes two additional 8-GPU clusters become available by mid-Q4. That is optimistic given procurement lead times; recommend we add fallback KRs if procurement is delayed (e.g., achieve X throughput with 30% fewer GPUs via Optimize).
- Hiring: we have one SRE and one Infra Eng headcount delayed to Q1; that creates risk against the reliability KR.
- Suggested mitigation: convert one product KR into a split KR: core latency target (aggressive) + operational resilience target (practical).

If we want the QBR to show a credible delivery plan, we should highlight both the optimistic forecast and the contingency. I flagged these in column 'Vivek notes' in the spreadsheet.

Attachment: resourcing_plan_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 18KB)

All — I like the direction. Small edit suggestions and one comms ask:

- Rephrase Objective 1 KR2 to be metric-first: "Achieve 95% query throughput SLA for standard routes."
- Add a success criteria sentence under each KR so the execs can quickly see what "done" looks like.
- Comms: we should include a one-paragraph "ask" for leadership (budget + hiring) on the intro slide.

I’m good to sign off on the charter if the metrics are tightened and we include the fallback language Vivek suggested. Can we lock this by EOD Monday so Marketing and Hannah can finalize the QBR sequence?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, GTM Strategy

Team — thanks for the fast turn. We’ll lock the charter with the following decisions (finalized in the attached QBR_deck_outline_v0.3.pptx):

1) Company objectives: keep at three pillars.
2) Metric targets: tighten as Marcus/Karthik recommended — product KR numbers are now explicit in the deck.
3) Resourcing: include Vivek’s fallback KR for Optimize-backed throughput if procurement slips.
4) Risks: Laura’s Top 3 Risks slide included.

Action items assigned:
- Marcus: update product KR wording and finalize numbers (due 2027-04-11 EOD)
- Vivek: finalize resourcing contingency language and tooling plan (due 2027-04-11 EOD)
- Laura: publish metric feed and update deck placeholders (due 2027-04-11 EOD)
- Karthik: draft the leadership ask paragraph for the QBR intro (due 2027-04-11 EOD)

We have a 30-minute signoff touch on Friday 4/9 at 10:30–11:00am PT (calendar invite sent previously) and a final dry-run with Hannah on Monday 4/12 9:00–9:45am PT.

Hannah — please confirm you have what you need to run the dry-run.

Thanks — approved to proceed.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
